content:
Nina (Design): quick sync on the capacity controls proto. main asks: make min/max steppers clearer, reduce accidental bursts, and add a tiny latency sparkline + accessible text. i dropped a static mock in figma: https://figma.com/file/xxxxx/capacity-mini-spark
Ethan (PM): thanks. can the UI warn when a change will push us above our SLO budget? simple red outline or an inline warning is fine.
Ravi (Frontend): can do. question: should the warning be tied to the current min/max only, or also to burst changes? bursts are short-lived but can still spike latency.
Nina (Design): warn for both. suggestion: inline text under the control: "Change may increase 99p latency by ~30ms" with a link to explain how we estimate it. keep phrasing non-technical.
Leo (A11y): accessibility concerns: 1) the sparkline is non-informative to screen reader users; include an offscreen summary like "latency median 68ms, 99th 120ms". 2) the inline warning must be in the page DOM and use aria-live when it appears.
Ravi (Frontend): good call. implementation plan: render hidden text via <span class=\"sr-only\"> and update aria-live region. also will ensure warning gets focusable if it appears after a change.
Sam (Infra): infra note: burst toggles can generate a flurry of scale events. we should debounce UI-initiated changes and group them into a single API request after 800ms of inactivity. also server should rate-limit to avoid oscillation.
Ethan (PM): 800ms seems fine. prefer shorter debounce for interactive feel, maybe 600ms? but we need rollback UX when API fails.
Ravi (Frontend): 600ms ok. i'll implement optimistic update + rollback toast. pseudocode:```js
let debounceTimer;
function onChange(val){
  clearTimeout(debounceTimer);
  optimisticUpdate(val);
  debounceTimer = setTimeout(()=> api.patch('/capacity', {val}).catch(rollback), 600);
}
```
Nina (Design): copy for rollback toast: short + action: "Update failed. Try again" with retry button. keep tone neutral.
Leo (A11y): ensure toast is announced (aria-live=\"assertive\") and retry button is keyboard accessible. also color contrast for toast buttons in dark theme.
Ravi (Frontend): noted. also accessibility on the stepper: use role=\"spinbutton\" and expose aria-valuemin/valuemax/valuenow and aria-labels that mention units (GPUs).
Nina (Design): stepper microcopy: show unit suffix: "2 GPUs" not just "2". also show a small helper text: "Min / Max instances" above the control to reduce ambiguity.
Ethan (PM): question on naming: earlier threads debated "Burst" vs "Overflow" vs "Temp capacity". my vote: "Burst (temporary)" is clear. avoids jargon.
Nina (Design): leaning "Overflow" feels off. will go with "Burst (temporary)" and a tooltip: "Automatically adds capacity for brief traffic spikes. Billed per-minute when active."
Sam (Infra): billing clarification: dedicated pools billed per-minute; include a note in tooltip for Hosted: "Hosted estimate only". also we cache billing rates at edge to avoid repeated calls.
Ravi (Frontend): UI detail: sparkline color indicates trend but we must not rely on color alone. include a small status dot with aria-hidden and status text next to it: "latency: 72ms (↑)".
Leo (A11y): for trend arrows use textual alternatives: up/down/steady. the status text must be visible and readable by screenreader. also avoid tiny font sizes for the sparkline label.
Nina (Design): mobile layout: stack controls vertically, hide hover-only affordances, show explicit "Preview" button to open the estimate sheet. desktop keeps inline preview beside sliders.
Ethan (PM): preview content: cost delta (dedicated estimate + hosted approximation), latency delta, and brief rationale: "based on current traffic and recent 99p latency".
Ravi (Frontend): performance note: calculate preview client-side using cached metrics and a simple linear model; call pricing API only when users click "full estimate" or after they stop interacting for > 2s.
Sam (Infra): agree. also include a server-side endpoint to validate the final request and return a firm estimate for billing during confirmation flows.
Nina (Design): microcopy strings to confirm: ["Preview", "Estimated change", "Rollback" toast: "Update failed. Try again" , tooltip: "Burst (temporary) - billed while active"]. happy to iterate.
Leo (A11y): i'll create a 5-point a11y checklist and run keyboard + screenreader pass on the staging build. please surface contrast tokens so i can validate colors.
Ravi (Frontend): i'll spin up a proto branch, wire debounce 600ms, optimistic UI, aria-live regions, and the offline summary for sparklines. PR link when ready.
deploy-bot: deploying branch capacity-debounce-proto -> staging at 2026-03-28 09:30 UTC :rocket:
Ethan (PM): timeline: prototype review tomorrow, dev spike this week, a11y pass Friday. thanks team.
Nina (Design): thanks everyone 3fb will post updated figma with the revised labels and mobile stack shortly.
